title: unused_numbers_case -- one case of the unused-number rule (plan.md 15.1 item 10)
description: A plan and the list the one rule in contracts/ gives for it: contracts/validate.py `unused_numbers`. Data and not code, so a copy of the rule outside this repository -- the console's, which imports nothing from the tree -- is tested on the same cases the validator is. Check 97 holds every case's `unused` equal to the rule applied to its `plan`. The plan is the part of a plan card the rule reads and need not be a whole card; it is never judged as one, because it is not a file of its own. Added 2026-10-27 by manager-microscope-20261003-1.

case.description: the case's name, the file's name after `unused_numbers_case_`

what.description: what the case holds and why the list is what it is

plan.description: the plan, or the fields of one the rule reads

unused.description: what the rule gives, in numbers[] order: each number nothing at run time uses, with its value and unit, and `from` its index in numbers[]
